verse.verse_1: By the heaven of the constellations!
verse.verse_3: By the witness and the witnessed!
verse.verse_4: The companions of the pit were killed
verse.verse_6: when they were seated around it
verse.verse_7: and they were witnesses of what they did to the believers
verse.verse_8: and their revenge on them was only because they believed in Allah, the Almighty, the Praised,
verse.verse_9: to whom belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and earth. And Allah is the Witness of all things.
verse.verse_10: Those who persecuted the believing men and women and never repented, there is for them the punishment of Gehenna (Hell), and for them the punishment of the burning.
verse.verse_11: (But) for those who believe and do good works, for them there are Gardens underneath which rivers flow that is the Great Victory!
verse.verse_12: Indeed, the seizing of your Lord is severe.
verse.verse_13: It is He who originates and repeats.
verse.verse_14: And He is the Forgiving, and the Loving.
verse.verse_15: Owner of the Throne, the Exalted.
verse.verse_16: The Doer of whatever He wants.
verse.verse_17: Has it come to you the story of the hosts
verse.verse_20: Allah encompasses them all from behind.
verse.verse_21: Indeed, this is a Glorious Koran,
